title: Commutation of geometric power returns via ordinary functor iteration
statement: Let $k$ be a finite field, $X/k$ a scheme, and $\ell$ a prime. Write $F_n=((\operatorname{Fr}_X^n)^{-1})_*$ on source adic sheaves [def-zl-source-constant-field-restriction]. Define $I_n:F_n\simeq F_1^n$ recursively by the identity comparison at zero and the pushforward composition comparison at a successor. Compose these with the ordinary functor iteration addition equality to obtain $M_{a,b}:F_a\,;F_b\simeq F_1^{a+b}$ and $c_{j,r}=M_{j,r}\,;[j+r=r+j]\,;M_{r,j}^{-1}$. For any source pro-etale Weil object $K$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], let $\phi_n:F_nK\simeq K$ be its recursively iterated return. Then $c_{j,r}(K)\,;F_j(\phi_r)\,;\phi_j=F_r(\phi_j)\,;\phi_r$ for all natural $j,r$, including zero.

proof.text: Inductively compare each geometric power pullback to the ordinary iterate of the single Frobenius functor. The recursive return becomes the source IsoAlgebra.strIterate under this comparison. The induction is the defining successor formula, functor map_comp, and associativity.

Apply the proved source IsoAlgebra.strIterate_add_hom in the two orders j,r and r,j. Naturality of I_n identifies each ordered product of returns with M followed by strIterate of the sum. The equality of sums identifies these two return maps. Cancel the comparison isomorphisms to get the displayed commutation identity.

theorem frobeniusPowIso_comm (K : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) (j r : ℕ) :
    (frobeniusPowerCommIso j r).hom.app K.carrier ≫
        (frobeniusPowPullback k₀ l X j).map (K.frobeniusPowIso r).hom ≫
          (K.frobeniusPowIso j).hom =
      (frobeniusPowPullback k₀ l X r).map (K.frobeniusPowIso j).hom ≫
        (K.frobeniusPowIso r).hom
